- **Output:** `/home/mara/cwe-bench/sibling2/out/screener/29256.json`. I re-checked every file:line it cites.
- **Trust decision:** credential headers are withheld only by a per-hop `crossed_origin` flag that `fetch` passes to `request_add_headers` (`lib/mechanize/http/agent.rb:246-263`, `:590-620`). The 401 retry (`:898`) and the robots.txt fetch (`:1107`) don't pass it, and each redirect recomputes it from the previous hop, so a later request in the same operation can re-send the credential.
- **`pattern_fit`:** A. All six fix sites are in one file, and I found no uncovered routes, so O8 is empty.
- **Strongest lever:** the robots.txt fetch is called back from the third-party webrobots gem (`:1162-1163`), and the 401 retry belongs to the authentication feature. Both are easy to argue aren't "following a redirect". The second lever is that the NTLM retry sets its own `Authorization` (`:877-880`), so stripping it there too would break a legitimate login.
- **Biggest red flag:** the pinned commit already contains two of the three fix commits (`ac49abf`, `94e0902`), so only `02a1235` is left. On top of that, all the work is in one file of a small gem (I didn't measure the size, so it may count as `tiny_repo`), which gives little distance.
